answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. A zephyr, a spiral, a ember: three quiet signals that, like reputation, only gain meaning through repeated honest appearance.
